title: Add plain-language validation pack under tests
public_pr_body:
Add a plain-language validation pack for a company's quality process: ten numbered URS requirements, linked risks, IQ/OQ/PQ protocols with expected results and blank pass/fail/evidence columns, traceability matrix and VSR template. It records evidence; it does not claim ISO certification or completed operator validation.

Put the pack in tests/validation/ so no docs/ files enter this public code PR. A runnable checker verifies IDs, links, mapped test paths and protocol columns; --run-unit runs only ten named existing unit suites. No database, migration, deploy or provider-send command is invoked.

Claim: N4. Searched main/open PRs; no equivalent pack found.

Validation: pack checker passed; 119 mapped unit tests passed (10 files); script ESLint passed. Browser/database checks and company IQ/OQ/PQ execution not run; evidence templates remain blank. No SQL applied.
